datasheet_identity.title: L2SC1623Q/R/S LT1G Series General Purpose Transistors

extraction_notes: The ordering suffix R selects the cited hFE rank 180 through 390 at IC = 1 mA and VCE = 6 V.
Cobo is retained at its cited VCB = 6 V reverse bias for independent voltage de-embedding.
The source gives fT at IE = 10 mA, not IC; no collector-current condition was invented for TF.
omission_reason: No exact source-supported curve coordinates were retained. The cited fT condition uses emitter current rather than collector current, so TF remains held.
